pipeline_name: Pump Station 06- Qassim PS Gas Pipeline

validity.recommendation: verify/correct StartYear1 (2021): contractor source says completed 2018; also reconcile SegmentCost (GEM 364M vs contractor 220.38M)
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real. This is Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion (MGSE) Phase 2, Package 2, the 'Central Region Pipeline' (a.k.a. 'East-West Qassim Gas Pipeline 1'), a 226 km / 46-inch underground gas line from Pump Station 06 near Riyadh to the Qassim power plant, built parallel to the existing AYQS-1 pipeline. Two INDEPENDENT sources corroborate: (1) lamar-industrial.com (LAIC Industrial Company, the EPC contractor's own project page) gives '226 km', '46-inch', 'from Pump Station 06 near Riyadh to the Qassim Power Plant', 7 valve stations, awarded 2015 / completed 2018, value USD 220.38 million; (2) DMS Projects (dmsprojects.net, an independent infrastructure-project database, PRJ00021819) lists 'Saudi Aramco - MGSE Phase 2 Package 2 - Central Region Pipeline', '226 kilometers of 46-inch pipeline', owner Saudi Aramco, status Completed. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas TRANSMISSION trunk line (12.5 BSCFD MGS gas-supply program; not NGL, not gathering) — confirmed. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate. Nearest roster neighbor P7712 (Pump Station 07 -> Pump Station 11, 422 km / 56-in) is a physically distinct MGS segment with different endpoints and specs; no other Qassim/Central-Region row exists. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco confirmed by DMS (Owner [ref] was blank in GEM -> filled below). Endpoints (PS06 near Riyadh -> Qassim power station) confirmed by both sources. SPEC: length 226 km and diameter 46 in agree across both independent sources (HIGH). CAVEATS / SPEC CONCERNS: (a) GEM StartYear1=2021 conflicts with the contractor page, which states the line was completed in 2018 (awarded 2015). The MEED ref currently attached to Start concerns a 2020 capacity-target deadline extension, not a 2021 commissioning, so 2021 looks unsupported — recommend correcting to ~2018. (b) GEM SegmentCost=364,000,000 USD vs the contractor page's USD 220.38 million for this package; the metenders source (currently cited) now returns 403 and the figure is unverifiable there. The 364M may conflate a larger package scope; flag for review, do not silently pass.

fills.researcher_notes: Owner [ref] was blank in GEM. DMS Projects (independent project DB) names Saudi Aramco as client/owner of MGSE Phase 2 Package 2 (Central Region Pipeline); the MGS network is wholly Aramco-owned. Filled Owner1=Aramco 100% with the DMS ref (page verified to contain 'Aramco', '226', '46', 'Qassim').

summary: P7711 (Aramco MGSE Ph2 Pkg2 Central Region / East-West Qassim line) is real and correctly classed as a 226 km/46-in gas transmission line PS06->Qassim, corroborated by contractor (LAIC) + DMS; spec concern: GEM StartYear1=2021 contradicts contractor's 2018 completion, and SegmentCost 364M conflicts with 220.38M; filled blank Owner=Aramco.
